name: hirefo
description: HireFO — AI-assisted technical hiring & live interview platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hirefo/shared && npm run build -w @hirefo/api && npm run build -w @hirefo/worker && npm run build -w @hirefo/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run infra:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run runtimes:build
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hirefo/shared && npm run test -w @hirefo/api && npm run test -w @hirefo/worker && npm run test -w @hirefo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hirefo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hirefo/api && npm run typecheck -w @hirefo/worker && npm run typecheck -w @hirefo/web
